scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in verifier sandbox; T0 result-level compare against paper-reported gold with tolerances that account for methodology differences (different DFT code, pseudopotentials, etc.).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for dielectric constants, polaron trapping energies, and rotational frequency ratios
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (dielectric constants), Table 2 (polaron trapping energies), and text (rotational frequency ratios). J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 2016, DOI:10.1021/acs.jpclett.6b01199.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published figures/table/text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper, not invented.

outputs.description: Dielectric constant tensors and average diagonal values for MAPbI3 with MA+ oriented along [100], [110], [111].
Electron and hole polaron trapping energies in meV for each MA+ orientation.
Rotational frequency ratios of the four MA+ isotopologues relative to CH3NH3+ (CH3NH3 = 1.0).

output_contract.notes: All tolerances are hidden. The checker compares the reported dielectric constants, polaron trapping energies, and rotational frequency ratios to the paper's published values. It also verifies the ordering of polaron trapping energies: [110] > [111] > [100] for both carriers.

steps.description: Check electron polaron trapping energies within ±20 meV
Check hole polaron trapping energies within ±20 meV
Verify ordering: [110] > [111] > [100] for both electron and hole
Check averaged diagonal dielectric constants within ±20% relative tolerance
Check rotational frequency ratios within ±0.02 absolute
